gap: No result ChatGPT got states one same-day price for every board in this set: on 2026-11-21 the under-$100 75% Hall effect boards run from $59.49 (Epomaker HE80, wired per Dejaflow) to $89.99, the MCHOSE Jet 75 is $78.99-$84.79 on amazon.com rather than the $64.99 on ChatGPT's card, and the Gamakay NS75 at $63.99 is the lowest-priced board with 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth among those read.
standout_why: Compared against seven pages I opened. keebspicks.net (cited) prices only the AULA F75 HE ($76.99, 'last check') and says its order is by Amazon sales rank, with no reason any board loses. hlplanet.com's guide lists older prices (NS75 $79.99, TK75HE V2 $89.99, HE80 $69.99, Jet 75 $59) and no per-mode polling. Notebookcheck (cited) covers only the HE75 Mag, with 2025 prices. dejaflow.com gives no exact prices. setupinsider.com's under-$100 page covers only three Redragon/DAREU boards, none of them 75%. PC Gamer and Tom's Guide (both cited) came back truncated, so I could not check them. Rivals therefore have part of this (scattered, older prices), but none has the whole set priced on one date with each board's losing reason. ChatGPT's own two answers also disagree on price for the HE75 V2 ($76.49 vs $89.99), the RT75 Pro ($69.99, $79.99, $94.99) and the Jet 75 ($64.99 vs $79.00). Limits: I could not read aulagaming.com, so both AULA prices are amazon.com reads, and the Epomaker HE75 V2's connection modes are unread.
decides: It shifts the wireless pick rather than the wired one. Wired and cheapest: Epomaker HE80 at $59.49. Wired with the finest maker-stated rapid trigger step (0.005 mm, 8K polling, 128 kHz scan): Epomaker HE75 V2 at $76.49. For a shopper who wants 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth, the Gamakay NS75 at $63.99 (the brief's partner read of 2026-11-21, not re-opened by me) undercuts the AULA Hero 75 HE ($69.34 amazon.com), AULA F75 HE ($71.99 amazon.com) and Yunzii RT75 Pro ($79.99 yunzii.com); that is the segment our row honestly wins on price. The Gamakay TK75HE V2 ($79.19) and TK75 TMR ($89.99) also sit under $100 on the same partner read. The Epomaker HE75 V2 TMR at $109.65 is the board left out for being just over the line. Wireless speed should not be assumed: keebspicks lists the F75 HE at 1,000 Hz on 2.4 GHz, Notebookcheck tested the HE75 Mag at 1,000 Hz max on wireless, and Yunzii's own page gives 1 ms wireless against 0.1 ms wired despite advertising 8K in both modes.
